title: Connective tissue disease-related interstitial lung disease is alleviated by tripterine through inhibition of the PI3K/Akt, apoptosis, and TNF-alpha signalling pathways.
authors: Zhu, Wen; Wang, Yifan; Liu, Chenxi; Wu, Yunxia; Li, Yehui; Wang, Yue
one_liner_zh: 该文研究雷公藤红素通过网络药理学和动物实验治疗结缔组织病相关间质性肺病，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Background: Interstitial lung disease (ILD) is the major cause of morbidity and mortality in patients with various rheumatic diseases. However, more interventions need to be sought. Tripterine, an extract of Tripterygium wilfordii Hook. F, has been widely studied for its powerful anti-inflammatory effect. However, its mechanism of action in treating connective tissue disease-related (CTD)-ILD remains unclear. Purpose: To investigate the mechanism of tripterine in CTD-ILD treatment by combining network pharmacology and an in vivo experiment. Methods: The related targets of tripterine were obtained after searching the Traditional Chinese Medicine System Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform, Comparative Toxicogenomics Database, GeneCards, Search Tool for Interacting Chemicals database, and SymMap database. Following this, Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man, GeneCards, Genebank, and DrugBank were used to screen the targets of CTD-ILD. A target-signalling pathway network was constructed using Cytoscape. Additionally, topological analysis was performed. Protein interaction analysis was performed using the STRING online analysis platform. Following this, Gene Ontology (GO) and the Kyoto Encyclopaedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) signalling pathway enrichment analyses were performed. Subsequently, the molecular docking between tripterine and the core targets was verified. Finally, experimental verification was performed in bleomycin-induced model mice. Results: A total of 134 common targets and 10 core targets of tripterine, including signal transducer and activator of transcription 3, tumour necrosis factor (TNF), v-rel avian reticuloendotheliosis viral oncogene homolog A, protein kinase B (Akt) alpha (Akt1), mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) 1, Jun transcription factor family, tumour protein 53, MAPK3, nuclear factor kappa B subunit 1, and caspase 8, were obtained. GO enrichment analysis revealed that, while treating CTD-ILD, tripterine was mainly involved in cytokine receptor binding, receptor-ligand activity, signal receptor activation, cytokine activity, protein ubiquitination, deoxyribonucleic acid transcriptase activity, etc. The KEGG pathway enrichment analysis revealed that the most significant signalling pathways were multiple viral infections and the phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase (PI3K)/Akt, TNF, and apoptosis signalling pathways. Molecular docking results revealed that tripterine had good docking activity with the core targets. Experimental studies also demonstrated that tripterine could inhibit the activation of PI3K/Akt, apoptosis, and TNF-alpha signalling pathways in lung tissue and significantly improve lung pathology and collagen deposition in the model mice. Conclusions: This study preliminarily revealed the potential molecular biological mechanism of tripterine while treating CTD-ILD might be related to inhibiting the PI3K/Akt, apoptosis, and TNF-alpha signalling pathways. Tripterygium wilfordii Hook. F. and its extract could be used clinically for treating CTD-ILD.
abstract_zh: 背景：间质性肺病（ILD）是多种风湿性疾病患者发病和死亡的主要原因。然而，仍需寻求更多干预措施。雷公藤红素（Tripterine）是雷公藤（Tripterygium wilfordii Hook. F.）的提取物，因其强大的抗炎作用而被广泛研究。然而，其在治疗结缔组织病相关（CTD）-ILD中的作用机制仍不清楚。目的：通过结合网络药理学和体内实验，探讨雷公藤红素在CTD-ILD治疗中的作用机制。方法：通过检索中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台、比较毒理基因组学数据库、GeneCards、化学物质相互作用搜索工具数据库和SymMap数据库，获取雷公藤红素的相关靶点。随后，使用在线人类孟德尔遗传数据库、GeneCards、Genebank和DrugBank筛选CTD-ILD的靶点。利用Cytoscape构建靶点-信号通路网络，并进行拓扑分析。使用STRING在线分析平台进行蛋白质相互作用分析。随后，进行基因本体（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）信号通路富集分析。接着，验证雷公藤红素与核心靶点之间的分子对接。最后，在博来霉素诱导的模型小鼠中进行实验验证。结果：共获得雷公藤红素的134个共同靶点和10个核心靶点，包括信号转导与转录激活因子3、肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）、v-rel禽网状内皮增生病毒癌基因同源物A、蛋白激酶B（Akt）α（Akt1）、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）1、Jun转录因子家族、肿瘤蛋白53、MAPK3、核因子κB亚基1和caspase 8。GO富集分析显示，在治疗CTD-ILD时，雷公藤红素主要涉及细胞因子受体结合、受体-配体活性、信号受体激活、细胞因子活性、蛋白质泛素化、脱氧核糖核酸转录酶活性等。KEGG通路富集分析显示，最显著的信号通路为多种病毒感染以及磷脂酰肌醇-3-激酶（PI3K）/Akt、TNF和凋亡信号通路。分子对接结果显示，雷公藤红素与核心靶点具有良好的对接活性。实验研究还表明，雷公藤红素能抑制肺组织中PI3K/Akt、凋亡和TNF-α信号通路的激活，并显著改善模型小鼠的肺部病理和胶原沉积。结论：本研究初步揭示了雷公藤红素治疗CTD-ILD的潜在分子生物学机制，可能与其抑制PI3K/Akt、凋亡和TNF-α信号通路有关。雷公藤及其提取物可用于临床治疗CTD-ILD。
